Field.Label: Broker host, username and password are read from IndigoSecrets.py (MQTT_BROKER, MQTT_USERNAME, MQTT_PASSWORD) when present. The values below are used as a fallback only.
Password (optional):
Field.Description: Leave blank if broker requires no authentication

Field.Label: The gateway ID is discovered automatically by listening on RAMSES/GATEWAY/+/info. Once discovered it is saved below. Clear this field and save to force re-discovery on next restart.
Discovered Gateway ID:
Field.Description: Auto-populated after first gateway contact. Format: 18:XXXXXX

Field.Label: The ramses_esp firmware stops retrying WiFi after a failed reconnect, so a gateway that drops off the network stays off until its power is cycled. If the gateway is powered from a smart plug controlled by Indigo, the plugin can cycle that plug automatically after a prolonged offline period.
Enable Power-Cycle Watchdog:
Field.Description: Cycle the gateway's smart plug when it stays offline

Field.Label: Cycle after offline (minutes):
Field.Description: 5-1440. Repeat cycles are spaced this far apart too

Field.Label: Max cycles per day:
Field.Description: 1-20. After this the watchdog alerts and waits for a human

Field.Label: Enable Debug Logging:
Field.Description: Logs all received RAMSES-II messages (verbose - use for troubleshooting only)

Field.Label: Author: CliveS and Claude Sonnet 4.6 | Version is shown in the startup banner (read from Info.plist)
